THE DECISION THIS EDITION CARRIES IS ITS OWN EXISTENCE. The CR (PL 119-103, signed 2026-09-02) funds through 2026-12-11, and this slot sits 11 days past that expiry. On this series' own 2025 record a funding lapse deletes the PRELIMINARY edition outright while leaving the number intact: reference months Sep-2025 through Jan-2026 all read 'Suspended' with no make-up slot, steelp_2509 through steelp_2601.pdf all return HTTP 404, and the FINAL FT-900A reports steelf_2509 through steelf_2601.pdf for the same five months all return HTTP 200. So what a lapse costs this series is the ~4-week head start, not the data — which is the calibration the researching lane should start from rather than re-deriving.
